svg.title: Wanjiku Kamande
svg.desc: Hello! I'm Wanjiku Kamande, an aspiring Software Engineer: dreaming big, coding bold. Animated Nairobi sunset: giraffes and acacia trees on the savannah in front of the city skyline, with the sun setting, birds flying, and a typing tagline.

g.text: Aspiring Software Engineer · Dreaming big. Coding bold. ✨
Turning bold ideas into real apps _
